approval_ref: direct user authorization to simulate human platform use, repair discovered bugs, and archive the completed current version

source_tasks.source_task: Simulate distinct human roles using the running platform, repair the bugs they expose, and archive a version-sized usability repair with reproducible evidence.
source_tasks.authority: Direct user repair and archive instruction after v0.4.10 closure.

mandatory_tasks.surface: requirement intake / Builder Team / application persistence / homepage
mandatory_tasks.acceptance: Starting Builder Team from a completed workflow proposal creates or reuses one durable application and draft, exposes live progress for the exact build operation, survives navigation and refresh, and presents the application with a customer-readable purpose instead of silently disappearing or dumping internal requirement text.
mandatory_tasks.required_evidence: Application persistence and display-description tests, Builder progress operation tests, option-based requirement intake regression tests, API behavior tests, and a maintainer browser journey that returns to the homepage and finds the application.

mandatory_tasks.surface: Engineer Studio / workflow canvas / natural-language workflow editing
mandatory_tasks.acceptance: Opening and selecting workflow blocks does not crash the frontend; canvas arrange and WASD navigation remain usable; right-drag references are captured without limiting edit scope; and model-backed whole-workflow editing can perform supported structural and semantic changes while validating every emitted operation before preview or apply.
mandatory_tasks.required_evidence: Node-selection and transform regression tests, model workflow-edit tests, frontend lint/build, and an Engineer Studio browser journey covering block selection, reference capture, arrange, WASD, edit preview, apply, and stable readable workflow summary.

mandatory_tasks.surface: acceptance gate / repair preview / evidence lifecycle
mandatory_tasks.acceptance: A failed real acceptance run exposes an actionable repair, keeps preview actions visible before long content, applies the selected workflow repair, automatically reruns the real tests, and reaches a truthful passing or failing terminal state without corrupting Markdown block identifiers or requiring an unexplained manual refresh.
mandatory_tasks.required_evidence: Acceptance repair context and workflow-edit tests, usability source contracts, two-request browser network evidence for apply plus automatic rerun, preview/running/passed screenshots, and no failed browser requests or console errors.

mandatory_tasks.surface: Customer Runtime / input validation / failure recovery / mobile result
mandatory_tasks.acceptance: A customer opening a failed run sees a customer-readable recovery state rather than internal errors; retry with missing input sends no run request and focuses the invalid field; correcting input clears the error; synchronous double activation creates only one run; the recovered run succeeds; and structured results render readably without raw serialized JSON on desktop or a 390-pixel mobile viewport.
mandatory_tasks.required_evidence: Runtime source-contract tests, failed-run recovery browser journey with request counts and accessibility state, mobile customer journey with layout assertions, readable-result screenshot, frontend lint/build, and backend run-state tests.

mandatory_tasks.surface: automation status / Connector operations / tenant and application isolation
mandatory_tasks.acceptance: Automation distinguishes not configured, unpublished draft, and active schedule states; Connector bindings, policies, authorizations, executions, callbacks, exercises, and related queries remain scoped to the selected application and tenant; empty operational surfaces do not masquerade as failures; and the existing durable scheduling and governed Connector behavior remains intact.
mandatory_tasks.required_evidence: Schedule boundary tests, durable collection tests, Connector cross-application and cross-tenant tests, maintainer automation and integration browser views, governance status checks, full backend regression, and restart health evidence.

mandatory_tasks.surface: human journey harness / regression policy / release evidence / archive
mandatory_tasks.acceptance: Reusable browser journeys model customer, maintainer, acceptance-repair, and failed-run recovery behavior; each journey asserts layout, network, console, state transition, and cleanup invariants; the current release gate includes the new regressions; the full suite has no current failures; artifacts are checksummed; and runtime health reports v0.4.11 after a clean restart.
mandatory_tasks.required_evidence: Four executable browser journey scripts, archived JSON and screenshots, current release gate, full pytest JUnit classification, targeted Ruff, frontend lint/build, script syntax checks, git diff check, evolution-control validation, artifact digests, and post-restart health response.
